notes: Open Decision DeBERTa-v3-large typed decisions (litert-community/Open-Decision-DeBERTa-v3-Large-LiteRT, Hub revision 7a276235b795e8ad3ae7ac6a9f237daa2098863a; v1 7842842e published 2026-10-01): DebertaV2Model (24 layers, hidden 1024) + span-pool head of com-kotobalabs/open-jev-deberta-v3-large (rev 188ee67a), one state + typed questions (choice / score / noul) -> one logit per option slot. Inputs inputs_embeds [1,N,1024] (host word-table lookup, fp16 table), attention_mask [1,N], q_routing / o_routing [1,128,N] (host-built mean-pool weights); output logits [1,1,1,128]; the host applies softmax at T=1.05 per question. wfp16 storage: the 146 FULLY_CONNECTED weights float16 + DEQUANTIZE, everything else float32 (1,785 operators). GpuOptions(precision = FP32) is the validated setting: the default GPU precision returned non-finite outputs on Mac Metal for every graph and, on the S26 with a finite-mask experiment build, finite but wrong answers (216/274). artifact_sha256 = the Hub LFS sha256 (resolve URL x-linked-etag / API siblings.lfs, read 2026-10-02), equal to the local export's sha256 verified before upload (scripts/verify_remote.py). Reference for parity = the checkpoint's own typed_decisions package on CPU fp32 (transformers 4.57.6) on the author's public test files (kotoba-lang/typed-decisions @ e65215db). Lane record: ~/code/standup/handoffs/2026-10-01-openjev-deberta-litert.md; run dir /Users/USER/code/codex-conversions/2026-10-01/openjev-deberta-litert. Window N=512: 500 fixture requests (all 300 ood-test + README example + 8 invented tickets + 191 random test rows; 1,302 questions, 754 boundary). The NPU row is the shipped graph's JIT compile failure; the lane's experiments with a -1e4 mask and a SafeLayerNorm 2^-3 pre-scale (unpublished builds, fp32 bit-identical) are not records (#174(3)): at S256 they brought the HTP to 274/276 answers (|dprob| <= 0.025) at 110 ms per request and Mac Metal fp16 to 200/200.
